definition: 2030 milestone on the Trauma Stasis Fields roadmap.

title: Readiness Estimator: Trauma Stasis Fields
definition: Estimates Trauma Stasis Fields readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Trauma Stasis Fields components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a field hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Trauma Stasis Fields Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Trauma Stasis Fields operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Trauma Stasis Fields installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 73581 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where stasis projectors monitoring, field logistics redundancy, or first response maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Trauma Stasis Fields Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Trauma Stasis Fields: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Trauma Stasis Fields — fields stabilizing trauma patients in place.

Phase 1 — Prove (stasis projectors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (field logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (first response): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (metabolic slowing): field hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and trauma-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
